law_name: Copyright and Performance Rights Act, 1994 (Act No. 44 of 1994; Cap. 406)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (works of unknown authorship: 50 years from first publication; audiovisual works and sound recordings: 50 years from making)
digital_protection: s.28(2) (as replaced by Act 25/2010): offence to make/import articles designed to circumvent copy-protection devices; no RMI provision found
fair_use_exceptions: Statutory list of acts not constituting infringement (s. 21)
